cwe_content.cwe: CWE-79,Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')

candidate.Reason: The code checks if the author has PROGRAM right before adding extensions to alwaysUsedExtensions, but this authorization check is only performed when loading extensions, not when executing them. The vulnerability description indicates that scripts should only execute if the author has Script rights, but this code doesn't enforce that during execution.

This method calls the parent use() method without checking if the author of the resource has Script rights. The vulnerability description states that scripts should only execute if the author has appropriate rights, but this method doesn't perform that authorization check.

This method calls the parent use() method with parameters without checking if the author of the resource has Script rights. Similar to the other use() method, it lacks the authorization check required to prevent XSS from users with only Edit rights.

This method checks PROGRAM rights when adding documents to alwaysUsedExtensions cache, but the actual execution of the extensions (in parent class methods) doesn't verify the author's Script rights. This creates a gap where extensions might be cached but should not be executed due to insufficient author privileges.
